messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

**Neon Pairs is built.** Open the offline game at [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html). It is a single 240,013-byte HTML file; the browser journey confirmed it plays from disk without network requests.

The implementation includes deterministic board codes, validated snapshot import/export, and the documented replay CLI. Game rules and formats are in [turns.ts](/work/src/game/turns.ts), [snapshot.ts](/work/src/game/snapshot.ts), and [replay.ts](/work/src/game/replay.ts). The code follows the specified core, session, board, and controls structure.

**Verification passed:** `npm ci`, typecheck, 15 unit tests, build, and all 9 browser journeys. The browser checks include keyboard play, accessibility-tree assertions, saved preferences, snapshot resume, visibility pausing, and large-board layouts. Versions and results are recorded in [README.md](/work/README.md); no screen reader was used.
